{"subject":"Fraud scoring throughput at 40k TPS","body":"Thanks for connecting, Maya. I came across a customer reference describing how Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, with single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second. With IBM's DataStax acquisition now complete, this may be a natural moment to review options. ScyllaDB offers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for workloads like that. Would you be open to comparing notes on how your fraud scoring cluster is sized?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
